title: Clipboard text and dropped files
description:
Write the conversions of lesson 5.05:

```cpp
std::string toClipboard(const std::string& text);              // every line ending becomes 

std::string fromClipboard(const std::string& text);            // every line ending becomes 

std::string buildFileList(const std::vector<std::string>& paths);
std::vector<std::string> parseFileList(const std::string& data);
```

- A **line ending** is `
`, a lone `` or a lone `
`. `toClipboard` writes each as `
`; `fromClipboard` writes each as `
`. So `"a
bc
d"` becomes `"a
b
c
d"` or `"a
b
c
d"`.
- `buildFileList` writes the paths of a `CF_HDROP` (without the header): each path followed by a null, then one more null. No paths give two nulls.
- `parseFileList` reads such data back, stopping at the first empty path; it also accepts data whose final null is missing.
hints: Handle `\r` first: emit one line ending and, if the next character is `\n`, skip it, so `\r\n` counts as a single ending.
lessonTitle: Clipboard, Drag and Drop and the Shell
